title: Settings
description: Configure model connections and Chat behavior
memoryModeDesc: off / automatic (update_memory_on_run) / agentic (enable_agentic_memory). Agentic wins if both would apply.
memorySettingsHint: User memory: mode, inject ranking, prune.
memoryGroupPruneDesc: Delete stale or low-value memories on a schedule.
chatGroupPrivacyDesc: What raw data reaches the browser.
numHistoryRunsDesc: Last N runs in context. Prefer 3–5; 0 disables history.
sessionSummariesDesc: Build a session summary and add it to the system prompt.
maxToolCallsHistoryDesc: Keep only the last N tool calls from history. Empty = no filter.
defaultToolCallLimitDesc: Global limit when the agent profile has none. Empty = profile default.
agenticMemoryDesc: Adds update_user_memory; the model decides when to call it.
memoryToolContentDesc: Extract memories from tool results. Off by default.
memoryPruneEnabledDesc: Drop old rows by updated_at, then keep top-k.
memoryPruneRetentionDesc: Delete when updated_at is older than N days. Default 90.
memoryPruneTopKDesc: After age prune, keep at most k per user. Default 50.
memoryInjectEnabledDesc: Score and keep top-k before inject. Off = all memories (Agno default).
memoryInjectWindowDesc: Only memories updated within N days; 0 = no window.
memoryInjectDedupeDesc: Keep the highest-scoring memory per topic.
notificationIntro: Your personal Feishu bot webhook is used only for MCP notifications you trigger (e.g. send_feishu_notify). It is never an MCP tool argument and is never returned in full.
feishuConfigured: Personal webhook configured ({{hint}}). Notifications prefer this URL.
feishuUsingGlobal: No personal webhook; falling back to the admin FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL.
feishuNotConfigured: Neither a personal nor a global Feishu webhook is set; notify tools will fail until one is configured.
clearFeishuConfirm: Clear personal webhook and fall back to global FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL (if any)?
baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required for OpenAI-compatible services
parallelToolCallsHelp: Controls the API parallel_tool_calls parameter. Leave unset to use the provider default.
privacyNote: Raw reasoning and tool I/O are off by default in the browser. Turning memory off does not delete stored rows.
retriesHelp: Agno application-level retries for recoverable 429/5xx errors. 0 disables. Default 4.
delayBetweenRetriesHelp: Wait before the first retry; with exponential backoff later waits are 1x, 2x, 4x…
exponentialBackoffHelp: Double the delay after each failed attempt.
httpMaxRetriesHelp: OpenAI SDK max_retries. Leave empty for the SDK default; prefer request retries above.
deleteActiveModelHint: This is the active model. Another model will be selected after deletion.
cannotDeleteBuiltin: Built-in models cannot be deleted; disable them instead
liveSearchHelp: Sends search_parameters when supported (native xAI; OpenAI-compatible via extra_body). Ignored for DeepSeek and native OpenAI.
liveSearchUnsupported: Live Search is only applied for xAI and OpenAI-compatible gateways.
xaiReasoningHint: xAI does not use reasoning_effort; pick a reasoning or non-reasoning model id.
baseUrlOptional: Optional for native providers (uses official default)
autoDefaultsHint: Protocol, structured output, reasoning, retries, and Live Search use optimal provider defaults. Toggle Live Search / Knowledge per turn in Chat.
usersHint: Assign product roles (analyst / author / approver / auditor). Users must re-login to refresh JWT scopes.
roleDesc_analyst: Investigate, chat, run workflows; no system config writes
roleDesc_author: Build workflows, knowledge, and skill submissions
roleDesc_approver: Resolve HITL and review run context
cannotDemoteSuperuser: Do not demote superusers here; clear the superuser flag first.
knowledgeRagHint: Maps to common Agno PgVector retrieval knobs. Low-score hits are dropped; empty results are allowed when nothing clears the threshold.
knowledgeRagSaveFailed: Failed to update knowledge retrieval settings
guardrailsHint: Agno input pre_hooks: PII detection and prompt-injection defense. OpenAI Moderation is not included. Applies to Chat, Team leaders, and Workflow step agents.
guardrailsEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, no input guardrails are attached.
guardrailsPiiEnabledDesc: Detect SSN, credit cards, and other personal identifiers.
guardrailsPiiMaskDesc: When on, redact matches with * and continue; when off, block with GUARDRAIL_PII_DETECTED.
guardrailsPiiEmailDesc: Treat email addresses as PII. Often noisy for SOC chat; off by default.
guardrailsPromptInjectionDesc: Block common jailbreak / injection phrases such as ignore previous instructions.
searchTypeTooltip: Agno PgVector mode: vector similarity, keyword full-text, or hybrid.
topKTooltip: Maximum documents returned. With rerank enabled, more candidates are fetched first then truncated.
vectorScoreWeightTooltip: Vector score weight in hybrid search (0–1). Text weight is 1 - vector_score_weight.
similarityThresholdTooltip: Minimum similarity/hybrid score (0–1). Below-threshold hits are dropped; 0 or empty disables filtering. Empty results are allowed.
contentLanguageTooltip: PostgreSQL full-text config language, e.g. english or simple.
prefixMatchTooltip: Enable full-text prefix matching (token:*) for short partial queries.
rerankEnabledTooltip: Cross-encoder reranking improves relevance at higher latency.
rerankMultiplierTooltip: Candidates = max(top_k × multiplier, min candidates) before rerank truncates to top_k.
rerankMinCandidatesTooltip: Minimum candidates fetched before rerank when top_k is small.
resetDefaultsConfirmDesc: This overwrites the form and saves to the server immediately.
rawReasoningDesc: Send raw reasoning to the browser. Off by default.
rawToolIoDesc: Send raw tool I/O to the browser. Off by default.
longTermMemoryDesc: Cross-session user memory. Off does not delete stored rows.
searchTypeDesc: Agno PgVector mode: vector similarity, keyword full-text, or hybrid search.
topKDesc: Maximum documents returned (top_k / max_results). With rerank enabled, more candidates are fetched first then truncated.
vectorScoreWeightDesc: Vector score weight in hybrid search (0–1). Text weight is 1 − vector_score_weight.
similarityThresholdDesc: Minimum similarity/hybrid score (0–1). Below-threshold hits are dropped; 0 or empty disables filtering. Empty results are allowed.
contentLanguageDesc: PostgreSQL full-text config language, e.g. english or simple.
prefixMatchDesc: Enable full-text prefix matching (token:*) for short partial queries.
rerankEnabledDesc: Cross-encoder reranking improves relevance at higher latency.
rerankMultiplierDesc: Candidates = max(top_k × multiplier, min candidates) before rerank truncates to top_k.
rerankMinCandidatesDesc: Minimum candidates fetched before rerank when top_k is small.
rerankModelDesc: Current rerank model (read-only, from server config).
